items.raw_excerpt: A man who discovered an ancient waka partially buried in dunes on the Chatham Islands says the government has made no guarantees over paying for its preservation.
items.summary_en: A man found an ancient waka, a traditional Māori canoe, half buried in sand dunes on the Chatham Islands. The New Zealand government has made no promises about paying to preserve the historic find. Local people hope the government will help protect this important piece of their culture.

items.raw_excerpt: A proposed public train-bus hybrid system to absorb an expected increase in commuters will however not be ready by Jan 2027, with Malaysia’s Transport Minister Anthony Loke saying that the government is still working out details.
